title: Restoring the Old Mill Pond
key_sentences: The old mill pond is the last open water in the eastern part of the town.
For decades it was a resting place for herons, ducks and the occasional kingfisher.
Since the sluice gate collapsed, the pond has slowly filled with silt and reeds.
Contractors will first remove about four thousand cubic metres of silt.
The sluice gate will then be rebuilt in oak, following the original drawings kept in the town archive.
Finally, a footpath with two viewing platforms will be laid along the southern bank.
Work began in September 2025 and should end in June 2026.
